_about: Every credential other than GITHUB_TOKEN that a spore-host/spawn workflow reads, and the least it may grant (#1602). A token GitHub issues to a person or an App, unlike GITHUB_TOKEN, can trigger workflows with what it pushes, tags or dispatches, so a token that could write spawn could push a v* tag, run release.yaml and reach kms:Sign on the spored signing key (infra/iam/github-oidc). GitHub shows no secret's type or scope to a workflow or the API, so github_tokens_test.go checks this file and the workflows' use of the tokens; the owner compares the live tokens against it (README.md).

tokens.why: GoReleaser clones spore-host/homebrew-tap, commits Formula/spawn.rb and pushes to main (.goreleaser.yaml brews:). Nothing else.
tokens.replace_with: A GitHub App installed on spore-host/homebrew-tap and spore-host/scoop-bucket only, minted per run by actions/create-github-app-token with repositories: homebrew-tap and permission-contents: write. Its tokens last an hour and belong to no person, so they cannot silently expire between releases (spawn#280). GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write another repository.

tokens.why: GoReleaser clones spore-host/scoop-bucket, commits bucket/spawn.json and pushes to main (.goreleaser.yaml scoops:). Nothing else.
tokens.replace_with: The same GitHub App as HOMEBREW_TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN, minted with repositories: scoop-bucket.

used_by: release.yaml:goreleaser:Notify docs site of new release
tokens.why: POST /repos/spore-host/spore-host/dispatches (event cli-docs-updated), which a fine-grained token may call only with Contents: write on that repository. The step skips when the secret is unset; sync-cli-docs.yaml's weekly schedule is the backstop.
tokens.replace_with: Nothing: have spore-host's sync-cli-docs.yaml poll on a schedule (hourly, say) for a spawn/truffle/lagotto release newer than what it vendored, with its own GITHUB_TOKEN, and delete this secret from every repository that holds it. Short of that, the GitHub App above installed on spore-host/spore-host too, minted with repositories: spore-host and permission-contents: write.
